title: Chapter 4.XXX.—How Shrovetide is anatomized and described by Xenomanes.

blocks.text: As for the inward parts of Shrovetide, said Xenomanes; his brain is (at least, it was in my time) in bigness, colours, substance, and strength, much like the left cod of a he hand-worm.
